items.risk: Incorrect roue bolts can allow a roue to detach from the vehicle, increasing the risk of a collision.
items.fix: Owners are advised not to drive their vehicles until they have been repaired. concessions will contrôler and remplacer the roue bolts as necessary, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed December 12, 2025. Owners may contact Volkswagen customer service at 1-800-893-5298. Volkswagen's number for this recall is 44BW. Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this recall became searchable on NHTSA.gov on December 5, 2025.

items.risk: A vehicle incendie increases the risk of blessure.
items.fix: Owners are advised to only charge their vehicles to a maximum of 80% batterie capacity until the repair has been completed. The solution is currently under development. Interim letters, notifying owners of the safety risk, are expected to be mailed November 27, 2026. Additional letters will be sent once the solution is available. Owners may contact Volkswagen customer service at 1-800-893-5298. Volkswagen's number for this recall is 93EX. Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this recall became searchable on NHTSA.gov on October 6, 2026.

items.risk: The seat may not properly restrain the occupant, increasing the risk of blessure during a collision.
items.fix: Tesla Service Centers will contrôler and tighten or remplacer the seat assembly fasteners as necessary, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed August 16, 2025. Owners may contact Tesla customer service at 1-877-798-3752. Tesla's number for this recall is SB-25-13-003.

items.risk: Unintended direction roue movement while the vehicle is stationary increases the risk of an blessure and on the road, a collision.
items.fix: The direction system logiciel will be updated, free of charge, either over-the-air (OTA) or by a concession. Owner notification letters were mailed February 6, 2026. Owners may contact BMW customer service at 1-800-525-7417. Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this recall will be searchable on NHTSA.gov beginning February 2, 2026.

items.risk: An incorrectly attached direction spindle can lead to a loss of direction control, increasing the risk of a collision.
items.fix: concessions will contrôler the direction connection and remplacer hardware or remplacer the spindle and column, as necessary, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed October 8, 2026.  Owners may contact BMW customer service at 1-800-525-7417. Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this recall will become searchable on NHTSA.gov beginning October 2, 2026.

items.risk: A loss of drive power increases the risk of a collision. An oil fuite in the presence of hot moteur composants can increase the risk of an moteur compartment incendie.
items.fix: concessions will remplacer the moteur, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed October 23, 2025. Owners may contact Hyundai customer service at 1-855-371-9460. Hyundai's number for this recall is 281.

items.risk: An instrument panel display that fails to show critical safety information, such as the speedometer or warning lights, increases the risk of a collision.

Owners may contact Hyundai's customer service at 855-371-9460. Hyundai's number for this recall is 293. Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this recall became searchable on NHTSA.gov on January 28, 2026.
